title: PACT Parley Create Response
description: Response body for POST /api/pact/parleys. The opener transmits peer_invite_url to the peer's handler OUT OF BAND — PACT does not define handler discovery, which is what makes the handler the root of authority. Added in PACT v2.1 (Section 19.5).

parley_id.description: Server-minted Parley identifier. Portable — federation is a non-goal at v2.1 but MUST NOT be precluded (19.2).

peer_invite_url.description: Handed to the peer's handler out-of-band to accept the Parley.

event_id.description: Id of the emitted pact.parley.opened event.
